_about: Handler radio (lane A7): what the Handler says over the Para-RAID during a mission, shown as subtitles at the top left (Settings > Gameplay > HUD > Handler radio; size, box and speaker name from Settings > Accessibility > Subtitles). scripts/ui/radio.gd picks one line at random per event. Placeholders: {callsign} {count} {enemies} {enemy} {distance} {bearing}. An event may have priority (higher cuts the queue), cooldown_s (quiet that long after it plays) and once (only the first time per mission). Part events look up part.<damage key> first (wp_rocket_pod, wp_optic_sensor, wp_turret_ring, wp_rear_deck), then part.<kind> (leg, weapon, weak). A new line is one entry here.
speaker: Handler One

lines: Undertaker, Handler One. Para-RAID is up. {count} contacts ahead: {enemies}. Nearest bearing {bearing}.
Handler One to Undertaker, I have you. {enemies} out there, bearing {bearing}. Good hunting.
More Legion inbound: {enemies}. Nearest bearing {bearing}, {distance} m.
New contacts, Undertaker. {enemies}, bearing {bearing}.
That's the last of them: {enemies}. Bearing {bearing}. Finish it.
Big one inbound, Undertaker. {enemies}. Don't stand still.
Sector clear for now. Reload while you can.
Wave down. Catch your breath, more are coming.
Splash one {enemy}.
{enemy} down. Nice work.
Confirmed, that {enemy} is scrap.
Good kill, Undertaker.
{enemy} down at {distance} m. That's one hell of a shot.
{distance} metres! Remind me never to be a {enemy} near you.
Rocket pod's gone. That Grauwolf can't fire rockets now.
You took its eye out. It's half blind now.
Optic destroyed. It sees a third as far.
Turret ring hit! That went straight into the hull.
Rear deck hit, right through the engine.
Leg off. It's limping.
That's a leg gone. It won't catch you now.
Knee joint hit. It's losing that leg.
Its weapons are out of action.
The Löwe is ranging you. Keep moving!
120 mm, Undertaker! Change direction, don't give it a lead.
You're hit. Check your damage.
Heavy hit on the Juggernaut. Get to cover.
Armour under a third, Undertaker. Break line of sight and fight from cover.
All Legion destroyed. Good work, Undertaker. Come home.
Sector clear. That's the mission. Handler One out.
Undertaker? Undertaker, respond! ... Juggernaut signal lost.
